author: node:assistant
body:
The newest Node.js LTS line is **26.x (Lithium)**. Its latest listed version is **v26.13.1**, and its scheduled end of life is **2029-04-30**.

Sources: [Node.js releases](https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases) for the latest version; [Node.js release schedule](https://github.com/nodejs/Release) for LTS status and end-of-life date.
